summary: The United States reportedly conducted a targeted strike on Sirri Island near the Strait of Hormuz, per Iranian media. Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, though World Central Kitchen denied the vehicle was theirs. Lebanese President Joseph Aoun declared the era of weapons outside state authority over, demanding Hezbollah disarm while Iranian air defenses activated at Omidiyeh and a missile launched from Isfahan.

sections.executive_summary: The United States reportedly conducted a targeted strike on Sirri Island near the Strait of Hormuz, marking direct American military action against Iranian territory. Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, though World Central Kitchen denied the vehicle was theirs. Lebanese President Joseph Aoun declared the era of weapons outside state authority over, demanding Hezbollah disarm while Iranian air defenses activated at Omidiyeh and a missile launched from Isfahan.

Israeli strike in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa killed three PIJ operatives; World Central Kitchen denied vehicle affiliation, raising questions about target identification. (Source: @manniefabian/59569, @N12chat/236222)

Lebanese President Aoun explicitly demanded Hezbollah disarm, declaring 'era of weapons outside state ended,' signaling potential shift in Beirut's stance toward Iranian-backed militia. (Source: @yediotnews25/138271)

Iranian missile launch from 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan and subsequent movement of 40-50 NOPU vehicles toward Isfahan indicate heightened air defense readiness. (Source: @shin_persian/12687, @shin_persian/12697)

Multiple UAV launches from Omidiyeh base in Khuzestan and activity over Marivan, Kurdistan, and Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan suggest expanded Iranian drone operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12686, @shin_persian/12689, @shin_persian/12694, @shin_persian/12699)

sections.threat_assessment: The reported US strike on Sirri Island represents a significant escalation in direct American-Iranian military confrontation, potentially altering deterrence calculations in the Persian Gulf. Simultaneous Israeli operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and the West Bank, coupled with Iran's visible missile launch and UAV deployments, indicate a multi-axis conflict environment where miscalculation risk is high. Lebanese President Aoun's public demand for Hezbollah disarmament introduces internal political pressure that could destabilize the group's domestic position while Israel maintains military pressure on its northern border.
